name: UK energy price cap
summary: Ofgem announces the January cap by 25 Nov; Cornwall Insight's final forecast is a 26% rise to about £2,166
state: The cap for a typical dual-fuel household is £1,723 a year until 31 Dec. Cornwall Insight's final forecast for January to March 2027, based on prices to 17 Nov, is £2,165.89, a rise of about 26% driven by higher wholesale prices linked to the Middle East conflict (Cornwall Insight; ITV News). Uswitch, updated on 23 Nov, cites supplier forecasts averaging a 27% rise. No newer forecast was found; Ofgem confirms the cap on or before 25 Nov.
for_you: Households on standard variable tariffs face higher bills from 1 Jan if Ofgem's cap rises as forecast. Ofgem and Citizens Advice publish guidance on help with energy bills.
rubric_hit: Alert: Cornwall Insight forecasts the January cap ~26% higher (£2,166), above the 20% Alert line
